requirements: R1: Locally validate OIDC ID token signature and extract claims directly

slices.title: Implement local OIDC ID token validation
slices.jtbd: When implementing local OIDC token validation for this epic, I want the token signature to be verified directly, so that unnecessary userinfo roundtrips are avoided and tests verify the validation logic.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an OIDC login request,
When the OIDC token is provided,
Then the system verifies the JWT signature and extracts claims directly.
Given an invalid or missing signature,
When the OIDC token is validated,
Then the system rejects the token and tests confirm the rejection.

requirements: R1: Validate OAuth2 state parameter against stored session/cookie state

slices.title: Implement OAuth2 state parameter validation
slices.jtbd: When implementing OAuth2 state parameter validation for this epic, I want the state to be verified, so that CSRF attacks are prevented and tests confirm the rejection of invalid states.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an OAuth2 callback request,
When the state parameter is provided,
Then the system validates it against the stored session/cookie state.
Given a missing or mismatched state parameter,
When the callback is processed,
Then the system rejects the request and tests confirm the CSRF protection.
